newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill on Monday, USDA said. Steers and heifers were not established on dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Dressed Basis Steers: No confirmed sales
Dressed Basis Heifers: No confirmed sales
Slaughter steer and heifer prices on a live basis also were not established. Buyer inquiry fairly strong, but most have no bids and were just taking inventory. Seller interest was limited.
Slaughter Heifers: No confirmed sales Sales confirmed: None. For the week: 2,100
